newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE'S NEW SHARES AVAILABLE BY FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: OTE'S NEW SHARES AVAILABLE BY FRIDAY.

text.p: OTE telecom investors will have to wait until Friday to pick up their depository certificates as distribution logistics kept them from reaching bank branches and brokerages on June 25.
A number of small investors who subscribed to the public offering complained that central Athens bank branches did not have their certificates.
"I went to a downtown Commercial Bank branch to pick up my certificates but they were not available. The manager said she did not know when they would get in," an OTE investor said.
But officials at National Securities which executed the massive block trade on Monday tranfering the shares from the state to the company's new shareholders said distribution had started.

"The depository certificates will be available by Friday. They have been handed over to courriers for distribution but it is not an easy logistic task," National Securities managing director Dimitris Matsaganis told Reuters.

Officials at the bourse's clearing house said more than 245,000 depository certificates had to be delivered to bank branches and brokerages. The retail component got an allotment of 80 shares per application.

Brokers told Reuters that National Bank , one of the lead underwriters and global coordinators for the issue, had notified them that the certificates would be delivered by Friday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
